d: Honey-blonde, curly, shoulder-length hair with a side-parted fringe frames a mature face with a youthful appearance and large, gentle golden-brown eyes. The slender build is dressed in a white blazer with fur-trimmed cuffs over a matching white skirt, complemented by a yellow scarf, black tights, and a black-and-white patterned undershirt. Accessories include large white pearl earrings and a dark necklace. Beside the figure are two shaggy black creatures with glowing yellow eyes, sharp teeth, and blue inner-ear accents, held by thin grey leashes.
